Assisted living, memory care and senior care homes in the Memphis area · Free for families

Memphis Senior Care Homes

Memphis Senior Care Homes is a free guide to assisted living, memory care and senior care homes in the Memphis area. Assisted living helps with bathing, dressing, meals and medications in a private apartment. Memory care adds a secured unit and dementia-trained staff. A care home is the everyday name for either; Tennessee licenses both.

What is Memphis Senior Care Homes, and when should you use it?

Memphis Senior Care Homes is a free guide for families choosing assisted living or memory care for a parent in Memphis, Germantown, Collierville, Bartlett, Cordova, DeSoto County and West Memphis. Use it when a parent can no longer live safely alone, or a hospital discharge is coming, and you need licensed options quickly.

Families never pay us, but communities do: senior living communities pay us a referral fee or a flat fee when they accept a family we introduce, and some buy sponsored placements, which are always labelled. The directory still lists every licensed community, paying or not.
